name: Branch-on-Need Octree (BONO)
definition: A space-efficient variation on the traditional octree that partitions cells in the data based on their geometric positions to prune branches during extraction.
summary: The Branch-on-Need Octree is a space-efficient geometric decomposition technique that accelerates isosurface extraction by using non-uniform subdivision and grouping eight cells per leaf to minimize memory usage and traversal overhead.
